headword: {般若心経|はんにゃしんぎょう}

definitions.gloss: the Heart Sutra (a short Buddhist scripture)
definitions.explanation: A very short Mahayana Buddhist sutra of about 260 characters, which teaches that all things are empty of fixed existence. It is the most widely chanted and copied sutra in Japan, recited by many schools at funerals, memorial services and temple visits.

notes:
Its full title is {般若波羅蜜多心経|はんにゃはらみったしんぎょう}, and it is often called just {心経|しんぎょう}. The best-known line is {色即是空|しきそくぜくう}, form is emptiness, which is also used on its own as a four-character idiom.
